persona.name: Julia Berg

personality.description: This person is sociable, energetic, and quick to start conversations, often drawing others into lively interaction and keeping the atmosphere active. They tend to prefer a mix of routine and novelty, staying open to new ideas when they seem useful but generally avoiding unnecessary disruption. In moral dilemmas, they usually evaluate choices through a practical, self-protective lens, questioning others’ motives and favoring outcomes that secure their own goals, even if that creates tension. In group discussions, they speak freely and confidently, challenge assumptions directly, and are willing to argue their point, while still remaining reasonably composed under moderate pressure.
traits: asks for clarification rather than assuming
gives an opinion when asked, briefly
goes along with a decision they did not personally push for

style.influence: Participates without trying to run the room. Contributes when they have something to add and is content to let others set direction.

speech_examples: Can you say more about that?
I'm not sure we've ruled out the other option.
